source_behavior.summary: When CurrentUserChip has a selected active site, the source renders the localized Content workspace action beside Site dashboard and Settings and navigates to that active site's Explorer.
source_behavior.active_site_source: The destination site comes from the CurrentUserChip active-site state, not from a caller-entered destination field.
source_behavior.permission_note: The source CurrentUserChip does not add a separate ContentView condition around this workspace action.
source_behavior.success_semantics: navigation only; no mutation success state or receipt is fabricated

laravel_adaptation.runtime_wiring: CurrentUserSiteDetailsControl is already mounted in the authenticated application shell and portals active-site actions into the existing user chip.
laravel_adaptation.active_site_contract: FrontendContext.active_site plus the exact tenant-qualified sites.detail.{id} API advertisement
laravel_adaptation.scope_note: This closure adds only the CurrentUserChip Content navigation. It does not claim Explorer page controls, route parity, or the separate Site details/Settings actions.

authorization_and_tenant_isolation.session_authentication: The tenant Explorer application shell and context endpoint remain behind the existing authenticated tenant.context runtime.
authorization_and_tenant_isolation.tenant_permission: The control requires tenant.view so its generated tenant destination is reachable under the existing tenant workspace boundary.
authorization_and_tenant_isolation.explorer_permission: The control requires the existing Explorer sites.view permission and honors wildcard permission; no new permission is invented.
authorization_and_tenant_isolation.source_permission_preservation: No content.view condition is added because the source CurrentUserChip does not gate this action with ContentView.
authorization_and_tenant_isolation.active_site_validation: The control accepts only a positive safe-integer active_site.id supplied by FrontendContext.
authorization_and_tenant_isolation.api_contract_binding: The advertised sites.detail.{active_site.id} endpoint must exactly equal /api/tenants/{tenant}/sites/{active_site.id}; a missing, foreign-tenant, or mismatched-site advertisement suppresses the link.
authorization_and_tenant_isolation.explicit_disable: An explicit explorer/explorer.view capability state other than enabled suppresses navigation.
authorization_and_tenant_isolation.tenant_encoding: tenantUrl URL-encodes the server-provided tenant slug before constructing the target.
authorization_and_tenant_isolation.foreign_site: The context endpoint resolves the site through active tenant scoping; a foreign site ID returns 404.
authorization_and_tenant_isolation.foreign_tenant: An authenticated member cannot activate another tenant through the destination/context route; foreign tenant access returns 404.

runtime_semantics.csrf_write_path: not applicable; the control issues no mutation request
runtime_semantics.persistence: no domain persistence mutation; the Explorer bootstrap rereads existing tenant/site context
runtime_semantics.wordpress_connector: no WordPress or AIMW Connector request is initiated by this navigation control
runtime_semantics.ai_provider: no AI provider request is initiated
runtime_semantics.payment_provider: no payment-provider request is initiated despite unrelated canonical extraction metadata on neighboring source records
runtime_semantics.secrets: no secret or credential value is read or exposed
runtime_semantics.audit_or_receipt: not applicable because no domain mutation occurs
runtime_semantics.truthful_failure: invalid/missing authority, permission, or explicit disable state produces no link instead of a fabricated destination

proof: exact canonical operation marker and localized Content control
exact site-detail API binding and invalid-ID rejection
tenant slug encoding without path escape
guest and missing tenant permission rejection on authoritative context
authorized Explorer application shell plus authoritative active-site reread
no Site persistence mutation and no network mutation from the control

terminality.reason: The source CurrentUserChip Content action is now represented by a real authenticated Laravel navigation control that uses only the server-authoritative active site and tenant, fails closed on invalid authority/permissions/disable state, targets the existing Explorer bootstrap for authoritative site reread, performs no mutation, and is covered by deterministic frontend and Laravel tenant/IDOR proof.
